title: Exact diagonalization audit of a rectangular frustrated J1-J2 cluster
summary: Reproduce a pinned three-tier Heisenberg exact-diagonalization workflow, then expose a hidden-coupling solver probe.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md and input/model_config.json. Implement the exact workflow and write the four numerical artifacts plus executable output/solver.py. The evaluator runs solver.py on a hidden J2 case.

inputFiles.name: problem_spec.md
inputFiles.description: Scientific workflow and exact output contract.

inputFiles.name: model_config.json
inputFiles.description: Visible rectangular-cluster parameters and numerical grids.

referenceFiles.name: hidden coupling fixture
referenceFiles.description: Evaluator-only J2 mutation used to exercise solver.py.

evaluation: Hard schema and finite-value gates, Hamiltonian residual, static sum rule, exact visible reference comparison, dynamic sum rule, and an evaluator-only hidden J2=0.62 solver run. Full score is 1.0; malformed or scientifically inconsistent submissions score 0.
workflowSteps: construct the Sz=0 basis and periodic Hamiltonian
diagonalize and form correlations/static structure factors
generate broadened dynamics and Lanczos coefficients
package outputs and a reusable solver.py for the hidden coupling
intermediateArtifact: output/solver.py is the reusable numerical workflow exercised by the evaluator-only hidden case

provenance.source_license: Apache-2.0 code repository; benchmark-authored task/data terms
provenance.change: 3x4 cluster, J2=0.35, 80 Lanczos steps, 240 frequencies, and hidden J2=0.62 probe

agentMustDo: Construct the Sz=0 basis and periodic J1-J2 Hamiltonian from the supplied model configuration.
Diagonalize the visible instance and compute the governed ground-state, correlation, dynamical, and summary artifacts.
Write ground_state.npz, correlations.npz, dynamical_sf.npz, results.json, and an executable solver.py under output/.
Keep solver.py reusable because the evaluator runs it against an evaluator-only J2 coupling.
